about_the_game:
Venture Capital is a visual novel where players take on the role of a newcomer to the venture capital industry, experiencing its various aspects from their perspective, gaining professional growth, seizing investment opportunities, and avoiding investment pitfalls.

The game presents players with numerous choices, from whether to invest in a project to choosing which female protagonist to develop their life with. Each choice leads to a different ending.

The game incorporates business education elements, featuring a built-in business encyclopedia covering topics such as private equity, incubators, and valuation, making it a suitable introductory business knowledge game for students or those just entering the workforce.
